verdict.rationale: Devin's own docs say repository indexing lets it understand the codebase. That indexing powers DeepWiki's auto-generated architecture documentation and Ask Devin's answers about code structure and dependencies, which covers the core of mapping and explaining a codebase. The docs only imply, without stating, that no manual context selection is needed, and no hands-on report confirms whole-codebase explanation quality. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that whole-repo mapping requires no manual context or file selection, any stated limits on large or unfamiliar repos, and independent or hands-on corroboration of DeepWiki and Ask Devin explanation quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: Indexing your repositories allows Devin to understand your codebase and enables powerful features like Ask Devin and DeepWiki
Use DeepWiki to navigate architecture and code with auto-generated documentation.
Ask Devin can answer questions about code structure and dependencies, and help you scope and plan tasks before implementation.
